intro: Professionals and everyday users convert feet per second (ft/s) to miles per hour (mph) when working across imperial and imperial standards in automotive speedometer readings, aviation airspeed navigation, maritime chart plotting, and meteorology. One feet per second equals 0.681818 miles per hour, while 1 miles per hour equals 1.466667 feet per second. Whether you are verifying speed specifications on imported equipment, cross-checking technical datasheets, or scaling practical measurements, this converter applies the exact NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 reference relationship with instant precision.

faqs.question: How many miles per hour (mph) are in 1 feet per second (ft/s)?
faqs.answer: There are 0.68181818 miles per hour (mph) in 1 feet per second (ft/s), which rounds to 0.6818 mph for everyday calculations. Conversely, 1 miles per hour equals 1.466667 feet per second.

faqs.question: How do I convert feet per second to miles per hour (ft/s to mph)?
faqs.answer: To convert feet per second to miles per hour, use the formula: mph = ft/s × 0.68181818. For example, converting 10 ft/s gives 6.8182 mph.

faqs.question: What is 10 feet per second in miles per hour?
faqs.answer: 10 feet per second (ft/s) equals exactly 6.8182 miles per hour (mph) using standard NIST SP 811 and ISO 80000 conversion factors.
